# #185 round-5 delta: PASS-WITH-NOTES

Head: `b901a64fb863599bc787dfa490ba22b1f15c2bb1`

Delta against `96f9f41a676e2d41868245715c719f589b757fb8` and reviewer output `5a530228ed4d30d0fc9ab89f3e96e0cdd6b73571`. **F004 is closed. F001-F003 repairs remain intact.** This clears the changed render paths, not every preexisting plain-text receipt.

## Verified repairs

The template-drift branch (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:3400-3436`) renders the template name, version and latest version. It emits a command only for a valid template name, role name and project slug; otherwise it prints fixed `--json` guidance. The command words contain no whitespace, controls, metacharacters or leading option hyphens.

`render::project` accepts nonempty lowercase ASCII letter/digit runs joined by hyphens, at most 48 bytes. That matches project creation, including its collision suffixes, rather than imposing the 32-byte directory-name cap. The updated ordinary drift test uses the real created-project spelling `my-remote`.

The hostile full-output fixture now enables template drift. Independent bad-role/bad-template cases suppress commands while the canonical row still prints exactly one; an invalid project suppresses the otherwise valid command. The new `--suggest` HTTP case verifies the hostile prime note is rendered while the structured prime field remains raw.

The changed request-list, output-list, holding-name, lineage/holding-seat, drained-request identity, claims-seat, reshape-prime and suggestion-name renderers use their matching grammars. The request **listing's** close reason is escaped and labelled. These are display changes, not normalization of stored keys.

## Notes: corrected dispositions and explicit deferrals

**N001, F142:** actual close/withdraw receipts still bypass the listing formatter through `data.line` (`main.rs:2959`; `http/requests.rs:302,398`). Those lines retain raw request ID, actor and reason. Drained diagnostic strings also need caller-field auditing; the claims listing's subject/release reason and related line text are not cleared here. The new receipt test exercises rows, not the `data.line` branch.

**N002, F135:** assignment/release window names and derived reasons still contain the stored instance (`community/directory.rs:1622-1635,1655-1663,2619-2625`) and are printed raw by `render_holdings`. Calling them daemon-made did not make their inputs safe. The new fixture has no window object.

PM explicitly deferred both preexisting, unwidened paths to F142/F135 in message `275a84df35ba238e-0000000000000015`; the PR body table was corrected without changing the head. They are not repairs certified by this verdict.

**N003:** plain state/session output is not limited to the caller's descriptor. `Command::State { id }` fetches a chosen target and appends its reported model through `render_session_status` (`main.rs:1996-2002,3756-3847`). I reported the table's contrary assertion to PM; this preexisting path is not cleared by the delta and belongs in the broader plain-text audit.

Raw JSON identities remain untrusted recovery data. Reading a note or shipped template intentionally exposes its content; neither this verdict nor fencing provides blanket semantic prompt-injection protection. The previously noted exact 500-boundary quote/backslash fence cases remain source-inspected.
